title: Romantic Getaway to Chennai: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Chennai. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Chennai sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
The magic of Chennai lies in its ability to surprise you at every turn. This guide is for anyone planning a romantic getaway to Chennai who wants to experience the real heart of this incredible destination.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Chennai
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Chennai](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1616843413587-9e3a37f7bbd8?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of India's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Charming bed and breakfasts in Chennai provide cozy accommodations with home-cooked breakfasts.
